name: @pipeworx/mcp-geoapify

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Forward geocoding: convert an address, place name, or freeform location text into geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Returns matched candidates with formatted address, lat, lon, country, city, and postcode. Example: geocode({ text: "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA" })

text.description: Address, place name, or freeform location text to geocode, e.g. "Eiffel Tower, Paris"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Reverse geocoding: convert latitude/longitude coordinates into the nearest street address. Returns formatted address, country, city, street, house number, and postcode. Example: reverse_geocode({ lat: 48.8584, lon: 2.2945 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: places
tools.description: Search for places and points of interest (POI) near a location, filtered by Geoapify category. Returns name, formatted address, categories, lat, lon, and distance from the center point. Example: places({ categories: "catering.restaurant", lat: 48.8584, lon: 2.2945, radius: 1000 })

categories.description: Geoapify place category (or comma-separated list), e.g. 'catering.restaurant', 'commercial.supermarket', 'accommodation.hotel'

lat.description: Latitude of the search center in decimal degrees

lon.description: Longitude of the search center in decimal degrees

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: routing
tools.description: Routing / directions: compute the distance and travel time between two points for a given travel mode (drive, walk, bicycle, transit). Returns distance in meters and time in seconds. Example: routing({ from_lat: 48.8584, from_lon: 2.2945, to_lat: 48.8606, to_lon: 2.3376, mode: "drive" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geoapify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geoapify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
